ACT IX OF 2018
ACT IX OF 2018
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA UNIVERSITIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Universities Act, 2012
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary, 7th
March, 2018]
No.
PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-173 / 2018 / 5037, dated
17.3.2018.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities (Amendment)
Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
on 26th February, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 2nd March, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012
(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. X of 2012) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of Schedule-I of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.X of 2012

2. Amendment
of Schedule-I of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.X of 2012.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012

entries shall be added, namely:
"(20)
The University of Lakki Marwat.
(21)
The University of Agriculture, Dera Ismaeel Khan.
(22)
The University of Engineering and Technology, Mardan.".
